headline: Fire Element Matchups
title: Aniimo Fire Element Explained | What Fire Beats and Fears | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Fire is one of Aniimo's nine elements, and it loves burning plants and ice. A Fire attack that hits a Grass or Ice Aniimo deals one point six times damage. The danger is Water, which hits Fire for that same bonus. Resisted hits only do zero point six two five times damage, so matchups swing fights fast. Check the in-game Counter chart before a tough battle. Which Fire Aniimo is on your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Fire element hits Grass and Ice for one point six times damage but is weak to Water.
